I am a graduate student in the MS in Civic Analytics program at the University of Illinois Chicago, graduating in Spring 2027. My work focuses on using data analysis in R to understand and improve public services and community wellbeing. Last year I used to work with the Government Finance Research Center (GFRC) as a research assistant helping with the Cook County project on water meter/sewer system, and in collaboration with the Pew Charitable Trust supported the project on expenditure forecasting.
